tutorial_extreme.reason: Prototype mechanics are not implemented by the runtime zone registry. Its v1 "ramp" stamp (angle/length) was renamed legacy_ramp when v2 claimed "ramp" as a primitive.

slalom_extreme.reason: Prototype branching, trap, boost-chain, and plunge mechanics are not implemented.

staircase_extreme.reason: Prototype fork, freefall, trap-stair, platform, and spiral-staircase mechanics are not implemented.

volcano_run_extreme.reason: Prototype heat, eruption, tsunami, collapsing-platform, and boss-caldera systems are not implemented.
